name: sweep_ground
text: A janitor pushes a floor broom away and pulls it back with both hands. Hands remain low in front of the waist, one hand near the belt and the other near the thigh. The broom handle slopes diagonally forward and down. Feet stay shoulder width apart; the body leans forward slightly. Make one slow, broad forward-and-back sweep across the floor in front of the feet.
